Lindsay: OK team — finalizing the cloud marketplace playbook for next sprint. TL;DR: need Terraform artifacts, SKU mapping, legal sign-off, packaging assets.
Sam: I've got the Terraform module for Azure and GCP ready, pushing to repo now. PR: https://git.company/repo/terraform-marketplace
Jess: Product needs the SKU matrix (free/paid tiers, seats, entitlements). Can someone attach the current one?
Arjun: Reviewing the MSAs — expect comments by EOD Thursday. Need list of data flow diagrams for Azure listing.
Lindsay: @Sam can you export the module as a zip and add checksum? Marketplace requires signed artifacts. Also add example var file.
Sam: Upload will include:
```
module "marketplace_listing" {
  source = "git::https://git.company/repo.git//modules/marketplace?ref=v1.2.0"
}
```
I'll add sha256 in release.
Jess: Attaching SKU matrix: https://docs.company/sales/sku-matrix-v2.xlsx — note: enterprise bundle (BUNDLE-ENT-REDWOOD) needs seat-based pricing.
Maria: Ops: need IAM roles doc and test account for publishing. @Lindsay can you confirm the org admin user?
Lindsay: I'll create publisher account in AWS marketplace staging by tomorrow. Adding owner tag.
Arjun: For legal, include the indemnity clause summary + export compliance checkbox. Also we need the customer data residency statement.
Mike: Quick check on packaging: images must be <=2GB and AMI ids need to be final. Who's doing AMI bake?
Sam: We'll coordinate with eng-infra for AMI bake. @Mike can you open ticket with bake specs?
Mike: Done — ticket #4567. ETA 3 days.
Lindsay: Great. Action items:
- Sam: Artifact zip + checksum + example var (due Wed)
- Jess: Final SKU matrix + packaging notes (due Tue)
- Arjun: Legal comments + data residency language (due Thu)
- Mike: AMI bake ticket follow-up (in progress)
- Maria: IAM/test accounts (due Wed)
We'll run a preflight on Friday, then handoff to Marketplace ops. :rocket:
CI Bot: deploy pipeline passed for terraform module (build-102).
